title: LDLS structured document
description: A document split into a tree of nodes. Each node is decoded with its own sequence ID; see schema/SCHEMA.md for the invariants and merge rules.

domain.description: Parser domain, e.g. markdown, html, json.

model.description: GGUF model whose tokenizer produced the token IDs.

merge.description: Parameters of the small-subtree merge rules actually applied.

n_tokens.description: Total tokens over all nodes (each stored once in the KV cache).

nodes.description: Nodes in pre-order. nodes[0] is the root. A node's id equals its index.

parent.description: Id of the parent node; null only for the root. Always smaller than id (pre-order).

node_type.description: Structural type. Markdown uses: document, section, paragraph, list, code, table, blockquote, html, rule, merged.

title.description: Human-readable label used to address the node (e.g. the heading text).

tokens.description: Token IDs of this node's own text (not its children).

positions.description: One position per token. Tree positions: consecutive, starting at the parent's last position + 1 (0 for the root). Sibling subtrees overlap.

seq_ids.description: Sequence IDs every token of this node is tagged with: the node's own sequence first, then the sequences of all its descendants.

n_markup.description: Tokens of this node that are pure markup/syntax or whitespace.

text.description: Source text of the node (for debugging; the driver uses tokens).
